# compose-desktop-kanban

> Kanban board core with keyboard-only drag and drop and screen reader announcements, WIP limits, undo and redo, and crash-safe persistence in a versioned line format Kotlin library `io.github.trysac:compose-desktop-kanban`, package
> `io.github.trysac.compose_desktop_kanban`, MIT licensed, Kotlin 2 on Java >= 21, standard library only.

- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the library and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
